name: code-clone-detector
description: Detect code clones across the workspace using LLMs

codeCloneDetector.llmProvider.description: The Large Language Model provider to use.

codeCloneDetector.apiKey.description: API Key for the chosen provider.

codeCloneDetector.modelName.description: Model name to use (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus, llama3).

codeCloneDetector.indexPrompt.default: You are a senior software engineer. Analyze the following source code and concisely summarize its core functionality in 1-2 sentences. Then list relevant technical keywords. Do NOT output any other text than the summary.
codeCloneDetector.indexPrompt.description: Prompt used for analyzing and caching code functionality.

codeCloneDetector.detectPrompt.default: You are a code clone detector. Find snippets in the given Target Source Code that are semantically identical or very similar to the Query Snippet. Return exclusively in format: File: <filename>, Method: <methodname>, Lines: <start>-<end>. If none, say None.
codeCloneDetector.detectPrompt.description: Prompt used for finding clones between candidates and selected code.
